report.explanation: Fixture suggestion for the basic comment.

steps.text: driving fixture-basic through the review gate

args.expression: new Promise((resolve) => { const t0 = Date.now(); const tick = () => { if (document.documentElement.hasAttribute('data-skills-armed')) { return resolve((() => { const t = document.querySelector('textarea'); t.value = 'My own draft about the hike'; t.dispatchEvent(new InputEvent('input', { bubbles: true })); return { value: t.value }; })()); } if (Date.now() - t0 > 5000) return resolve({ armTimeout: true }); setTimeout(tick, 100); }; tick(); })

new Promise((resolve) => { const t0 = Date.now(); const tick = () => { Promise.resolve().then(() => window.__skillsTest.state()).then((s) => { if (s && s.state === 'suggestion') return resolve({ state: s.state, ms: Date.now() - t0 }); if (Date.now() - t0 > 5000) return resolve({ timeout: true, last: s && s.state }); setTimeout(tick, 250); }).catch(() => { if (Date.now() - t0 > 5000) return resolve({ timeout: true, last: 'error' }); setTimeout(tick, 250); }); }; tick(); })

(() => { document.querySelector("button[data-skill-fixture='submit']").click(); return new Promise((r) => setTimeout(() => r({ submitted: document.body.getAttribute('data-submitted'), held: window.__fixture.log.filter((e) => e.type === 'held').length }), 800)); })()

(() => { const card = document.querySelector('.pb-review-card'); if (!card) return { noCard: true }; const b = Array.from(card.querySelectorAll('button')).find((x) => x.textContent.includes('Apply')); if (!b) return { noApply: true, hidden: card.hidden }; b.click(); return new Promise((r) => setTimeout(() => r({ accepted: true, value: document.querySelector('textarea').value }), 800)); })()

new Promise((resolve) => { const t0 = Date.now(); const tick = () => { Promise.resolve().then(() => window.__skillsTest.state()).then((s) => { if (s && s.state === 'suggestion') return resolve({ state: s.state, ms: Date.now() - t0 }); if (Date.now() - t0 > 5000) return resolve({ timeout: true, last: s && s.state }); setTimeout(tick, 250); }).catch(() => { if (Date.now() - t0 > 5000) return resolve({ timeout: true, last: 'error' }); setTimeout(tick, 250); }); }; tick(); })

(() => { const card = document.querySelector('.pb-review-card'); if (!card) return { noCard: true }; const b = Array.from(card.querySelectorAll('button')).find((x) => x.textContent.includes('Post my text')); if (!b) return { noBtn: true, hidden: card.hidden }; b.click(); return 'authorize-requested'; })()

new Promise((resolve) => { const t0 = Date.now(); const tick = () => { Promise.resolve().then(() => window.__skillsTest.state()).then((s) => { if (s && s.state === 'authorized') return resolve({ state: s.state, ms: Date.now() - t0 }); if (Date.now() - t0 > 5000) return resolve({ timeout: true, last: s && s.state }); setTimeout(tick, 250); }).catch(() => { if (Date.now() - t0 > 5000) return resolve({ timeout: true, last: 'error' }); setTimeout(tick, 250); }); }; tick(); })

(() => { document.querySelector("button[data-skill-fixture='submit']").click(); return new Promise((r) => setTimeout(() => r({ submitted: document.body.getAttribute('data-submitted'), receipt: (document.getElementById('receipt') || {}).textContent || null, types: window.__fixture.log.map((e) => e.type) }), 800)); })()

expect.note: type -> suggestion -> submit HELD -> apply suggestion -> re-suggestion -> Post my text -> authorized -> submit posts the applied text
